premise: Six hours before her first stadium concert, the reel star from Chandpur vanished from her hotel in the city. You're the new intern at the City Police Data Cell. Your only witness is the data.

beats.speaker: mentor
beats.body:
Five names keep coming up. Put them in a proper table — no notebook scribbles.
We talk to databases in **SQL**. Let's start.

Every column has a **data type**. These are used often:

| Data type | Syntax |
|---|---|
| Integer | INTEGER / INT |
| Float | FLOAT |
| String | VARCHAR |
| Text | TEXT |
| Date | DATE |
| Time | TIME |
| Datetime | DATETIME |
| Boolean | BOOLEAN |

Notes: Boolean values are stored as integers **0 (FALSE)** and **1 (TRUE)**.
A date looks like `'YYYY-MM-DD'`. A datetime looks like `'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'`.

beats.prompt: Pick the best data type for each piece of case information.

beats.body:
`CREATE TABLE` creates a new table in the database.
```sql
CREATE TABLE table_name (
  column1 type1,
  column2 type2,
  ...
);
```

beats.ask:
Create a table `suspects` with these columns:

| column_name | data_type |
|---|---|
| name | VARCHAR(200) |
| role | VARCHAR(100) |
| phone | VARCHAR(15) |
| age | INT |

grading.inspect: SELECT lower(name) AS column_name, CASE WHEN upper(type) IN ('INT', 'INTEGER') THEN 'INTEGER' ELSE upper(trim(substr(type, 1, instr(type || '(', '(') - 1))) END AS data_type FROM pragma_table_info('suspects');

beats.body:
To check the details of a table, use `PRAGMA TABLE_INFO`:
```sql
PRAGMA TABLE_INFO(table_name);
```
It shows every column with its type.

beats.ask: Check the structure of your `suspects` table.
setup: CREATE TABLE suspects (name VARCHAR(200), role VARCHAR(100), phone VARCHAR(15), age INT);
